translations.literal: Qin Hui, style name Huizhi, was a native of Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui, whose style name was Huizhi, came from Jiangning.

translations.zh: 登政和五年第，補密州教授。
translations.literal: He passed the examination in the fifth year of Zhenghe and was appointed professor at Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the civil examination in the fifth year of the Zhenghe era and was appointed professor at Mizhou.

translations.zh: 繼中詞學兼茂科，歷太學學正。
translations.literal: He next passed the metrical-and-letters combined excellence examination and served as Rectifier of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: He next passed the metrical-and-letters combined excellence examination and served as Rectifier of the Imperial University.

translations.zh: 靖康元年，金兵攻汴京，遣使求三鎮，檜上兵機四事：一言金人要請無厭，乞止許燕山一路；
translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, when Jurchen troops attacked Bianjing and sent envoys demanding the Three Prefectures, Hui submitted four points on military strategy: first, that the Jurchens' demands were insatiable and the court should agree only to the Yan Mountains route;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jingkang era, when Jurchen troops attacked Bianjing and sent envoys demanding the Three Prefectures, Hui submitted four points on military strategy: first, that the Jurchens' demands were insatiable and the court should agree only to the Yan Mountains route;

translations.zh: 二言金人狙詐，守禦不可緩；
translations.literal: second, that the Jurchens were cunning and deceitful and defense must not be relaxed;
translations.idiomatic: second, that the Jurchens were cunning and deceitful and defense must not be relaxed;

translations.zh: 三乞集百官詳議，擇其當者載之誓書；
translations.literal: third, that all officials be assembled for detailed deliberation and that what was fitting be entered into the oath document;
translations.idiomatic: third, that all officials be assembled for detailed deliberation and that what was fitting be entered into the oath document;

translations.zh: 四乞館金使於外，不可令入門及引上殿。
translations.literal: fourth, that Jurchen envoys be lodged outside and not allowed to enter the gates or be led into the hall of audience.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, that Jurchen envoys be lodged outside and not allowed to enter the gates or be led into the audience hall.

translations.literal: He was appointed Outer Gentleman in the Bureau of Military Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Outer Gentleman in the Bureau of Military Appointments.

translations.zh: 尋屬張邦昌為幹當公事，檜言：「是行專為割地，與臣初議矛盾，失臣本心。」
translations.literal: Soon he was assigned to Zhang Bangchang as handler of official business. Hui said: "This mission is solely for ceding territory; it contradicts my original proposal and betrays my true intent."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was assigned to Zhang Bangchang as handler of official business. Hui said, "This mission is solely for ceding territory; it contradicts my original proposal and betrays my true intent."

translations.literal: He submitted three memorials declining, and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted three memorials declining, and permission was granted.
